title: SPAR ML Adapter Subject
description: Structured subject payload for the spar_domain_ml benchmark claim-drift adapter.

task_family.description: ML task family (e.g. image_classification, text_classification, object_detection)

dataset.description: Primary evaluation dataset (e.g. ImageNet-1k, GLUE, COCO)

split.description: Evaluation split used (e.g. val, test, dev)

metric_name.description: Primary metric name (e.g. top1_accuracy, f1, map)

metric_direction.description: Whether higher or lower values indicate better performance

baseline_name.description: Name of the comparison baseline (required when sota_claimed=true)

baseline_value.description: Baseline metric value for comparison (required when sota_claimed=true)

generalization_claimed.description: Author claims general applicability beyond evaluation scope

robustness_claimed.description: Author claims robustness to distribution shift or perturbations

robustness_evaluated.description: Whether robustness (noise, perturbation) evaluation was performed

claim_scope_restricted.description: Whether the paper explicitly restricts generalization claims to the evaluation scope
